title: Task
readOnly: This Agent was deleted. Its Task history stays readable, but nothing new can be sent.
empty: Send a message to start this Task. {{name}} can read files only in its own Workdir.
offline: The Machine is offline. Send once it's back.
queued: You can send; it waits until this Turn ends

budget.body: New work starts at 04:00 in {{machine}}'s time, or when you add Budget. Files it changed are still there.

approval.title: Can I run this?
approval.domainTitle: Can I go out to this?
approval.domainBody: This domain is not in {{name}}'s Egress.
approval.closed: Its Turn ended before anyone answered
approval.steer: Tell it what to do instead
approval.covers: Trim the end to leave the prefix you mean. This entry covers every command that starts that way.
approval.doesNotCover: This does not cover the command, so it still asks.
approval.forSchedule: Approve, and let this Schedule do it

interrupted.title: {{machine}} started again mid-Turn
interrupted.body: The files it changed are still there, and {{name}} won't carry on by itself, because it could run the same command twice

stop.title: Stop this Turn?

authenticate.always: Add {{entries}} to the Allowlist and approve
authenticate.scope: Let this Schedule run {{entries}} without asking

changesNote: Counts only files the Agent changed with its edit and write tools
failedBody: Files it already changed are still there. Send a message and {{name}} can carry on.

details.title: Task details
details.hintOffline: You can rename it once the Machine is online
details.hintFirst: This is the first message for now. The Agent names the Task when its first Turn ends, or tap to name it yourself.
details.offline: The Machine is offline. You can rename the Task and stop a Turn once it is back. What is below is the latest this device has.

context.heading: Context
context.threshold: The line at 70% is where the Runtime compacts the context on its own
context.thresholdCompacted: The line at 70% is where the Runtime compacts the context on its own. This Task was compacted {{count}} times
context.none: No breakdown yet. It shows once the next Turn talks to the model
context.footer: A rough count from the latest Turn, about 3 characters a token. The Provider's own count may differ a little (ADR 0041)

system.label: System prompt
system.hint: How the Runtime tells the Agent to work

tools.label: Tools
tools.hint: The tool descriptions sent every time

summary.label: Compacted summary
summary.hint: Stands in for the earlier conversation

you.label: Your messages
you.hint: What you sent in this Task

agent.label: The Agent's answers
agent.hint: Its words and the commands it called

results.label: Tool results
results.hint: Files it read and what commands printed

changed.heading: Files the Agent changed
changed.none: No files changed in this Task yet
changed.footer: Only files changed with edit and write. What a bash command changed cannot be told from the log.

sent.heading: Files sent
sent.none: The Agent has not sent a file in this Task

steering.title: Answering the Approval: telling it what to do instead

skipped.title: Nobody was watching this round, so this command did not run
skipped.domainTitle: Nobody was watching this round, so it did not reach this domain
skipped.body: This command is not in the Allowlist or in what this Schedule may do. Allow it and the next rounds run it without asking.
skipped.covered: This Schedule may do it from the next round on
skipped.domainBody: For the next rounds to reach it, the domain has to be in the Agent's Egress.

due.schedule: A Schedule ran on its own at {{time}}
due.idle: Idle Work started on its own at {{time}}
due.watch: A Watch started on its own at {{time}}

ranNow.idle: Someone started this Idle Work piece now

question.expired: Nobody answered in time; the Agent chose itself
question.closed: The Turn ended before anyone answered
question.notYours: Waiting for whoever asked for this
